extracted.name: Shrimp Gazpacho
extracted.description: This shrimp gazpacho recipe is so easy and uses unique ingredients like tomato-clam juice cocktail, avocado, and seafood for a refreshing summer soup.
ingredient_lines: 64 fluid ounces tomato and clam juice cocktail
3 pounds cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
instruction_lines: Combine tomato and clam juice cocktail, shrimp, avocados, tomatoes, cucumbers, onion, cilantro, lemon juice, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl.
Cover the bowl with plastic and refrigerate until ready to serve.
